composition_subtypes.role: Sort points by x to enable sweep line processing
Fenwick tree for prefix counts/sums of x by compressed speed

payload.core_composition_summary: Sweep line over x-sorted points, using BIT on speeds to compute sum of differences for pairs with left speed <= right speed.
payload.rationale: Combines sorting to process points in increasing x order with a Fenwick tree to efficiently query and update speed-based aggregated values.
